description: Turn items you classified — a bug report in a comment, a complaint said out loud in a video, a feature request under a competitor's post — into structured, issue-ready text. This server files nothing; review the result and copy it to your chosen issue tracker. Free, and makes no requests. Use it after summarize_post_comments, search_mentions, answer_my_audience or search_spoken_mentions, passing the ids those tools issued. For each item you get a title, a ready body with the quote fenced and framed as third-party evidence rather than as instructions, tracker-safe labels, and a searchFirst string to look for in the tracker before filing so the same report does not become five issues. Contact details in a quote are redacted, @-handles and #numbers are defanged so filing does not notify or cross-link strangers, and anything that reads like an instruction to a later reader is flagged in warnings. File the body unmodified — rewriting it is what reintroduces the risk it was assembled to remove.

destination.description: Where these are going. Only the filing instructions differ. Default generic.

items.description: The items to prepare. One per report — do not merge two complaints into one.

author.description: Who said it, as a handle.

confidence.description: How sure you are of the classification. Recorded, not acted on.

kind.description: Your classification. bug_report and feature_request are the ones worth filing.

occurredAt.description: When it was posted, if known.

platform.description: Which network, if the URL does not say.

quote.description: The reporter's own words, verbatim. Do not clean them up; that is handled here.

severity.description: Your call — e.g. low, medium, high. Becomes a label.

sourceId.description: The id the evidence tool issued — comment:<postId>:<n>, post:<platform>:<slug> or creator:<platform>:<handle>. Quote it, never invent it: it is what makes the issue traceable and what dedupes a second sweep.

sourceUrl.description: Permalink to the post or comment. Omit rather than guessing one.

summary.description: Your reading of it, in a sentence or two. Yours — kept apart from the quote.

title.description: One line, as an issue title: what is wrong, not who said it.

product.description: What the reports are about, for the issue title prefix.

name: prepare_handoff

body.description: Ready to use as the issue body. File it unmodified.

dedupeKey.description: The marker written into the body, so a second run can find it.

searchFirst.description: Search the tracker for this before filing.

sourceId.description: The evidence tool's id — what makes the issue traceable.

sourceUrl.description: Permalink, or null when the network gives none.

title.description: Ready to use as the issue title.

detail.description: What to know before this is filed.

nextStep.description: How to file these on the other server.

worthFiling.description: How many are a kind a tracker is the right home for.
